quests.title: Відсутній предмет
quests.desc: Mixing &#99F0F0Stainless Steel&r, &#ADDBDBAluminium&r and &#E9A8F7Chromium Dust&r will give us &#EBA844Kanthal Dust&r.

quests.title: Відсутній предмет
quests.desc: &#EBA844Kanthal Dust&r must be smelted in an &#816DF7Electric Blast Furnace&r.

quests.title: Відсутній предмет
quests.desc: The &#EBA844Kanthal Hot Ingot&r can be cooled down using the &#6DC0F7Vacuum Freezer&r.

quests.title: Відсутній предмет
quests.desc:
The &#EBA844Kanthal Ingot&r can be processed into Fine Wire, which can be molded into Cable to finally make the &#EBA844Kanthal Coils&r. 

&#EBA844Kanthal Coils&r allow our &#816DF7Electric Blast Furnace&r to run at much higher &#F76D6Dtemperature&r, allowing more recipes to work.

You must switch the coils in the GUI of &#816DF7Electric Blast Furnace&r.

{image:atm:textures/questpics/modernindustrialization/switch_to_kanthal.png width:150 height:75 align:center}

quests.title: Відсутній предмет
quests.desc: &#CFB951Kanthal Coils&r will allow us to process &#C356C4Raw Titanium&r into &#DF9DE0Titanium Hot Ingots&r. This process requires &#D49B70Manganese Sulfuric Solution&r.

quests.title: Titanium Ingot
quests.desc: &#DF9DE0Titanium Hot Ingots&r can now be cooled down in the &#5CD1CFVacuum Freezer&r to get usable &#F069F0Titanium Ingots&r.

quests.title: Відсутній предмет
quests.desc: You can find &#6E2D6ETungsten Ore&r around the world easily. Breaking it will yield &#A140A1Raw Tungsten&r.

quests.title: Відсутній предмет
quests.desc: You can crush down the &#A140A1Raw Tungsten&r in one of many ways to get &#C452C4Tungsten Dust&r.

quests.title: Відсутній предмет
quests.desc: &#C452C4Tungsten Dust&r needs to be broken down to a much smaller variant to allow its processing.

quests.title: Відсутній предмет
quests.desc: An &#3ABEC7Electric Compressor allows you to turn &#CE5ADBTungsten Tiny Dust&r into &#AF22BFTungsten Nuggets&r.

quests.title: Відсутній предмет
quests.desc: The &#A57DE3Packer&r will now allow us to combine &#7DD2E3Stainless Steel&r, &#B37DE3Tungsten&r and &#E37DDBTitanium Ingot&r into a new &#3946E3Mixed Blastproof Ingot&r.

quests.title: Відсутній предмет
quests.desc: As of now, you can very inefficiently make &#986FC7Blastproof Alloy Plates&r in an &#6F93C7Electric Compressor&r using the &#3946E3Mixed Blastproof Ingot&r.

quests.title: Відсутній предмет
quests.desc: The &#DB62DEImplosion Compressor&r uses the power of explosives to combine resources. It can be used to get more efficient &#8762DEMixed Blastproof Alloy Ingots&r as well as many more useful resources.

quests.title: Відсутній предмет
quests.desc:
The &#6AADD9Distillation Tower&r is the upgraded form of &#A3D2F0Distillery&r. Its major benefit is that it gives you multiple outputs for the same input.

To build the structure, you must open the GUI of the &#6AADD9Distillation Tower&r block and choose the height. Height depends on how many outputs you need. To process &#76759ECrude Oil&r, you need a height of 3 blocks.

quests.title: Відсутній предмет
Відсутній предмет
quests.desc: The &#74C3DBAir Intake&r when put in a &#46CAF2Vacuum Freezer&r will yield you &#B5E7F7Liquid Air&r.

quests.title: Centrifuging Air
quests.desc: Centrifuging &#B5E7F7Liquid Air&r will give you 3 outputs: &#A5CAD9Oxygen&r, &#78ADC2Nitrogen&r and &#DD91EDArgon&r. We will use this &#DD91EDArgon&r in the near future.

quests.title: Advanced Distillation
quests.desc: To obtain &#994ABAStyrene&r, you must react &#C2C969Iron Dust&r with &#69C9B6EthylBenzene&r and Steam. &#69C9B6EthylBenzene&r is the product of distilling &#CDCF95Steam Cracked Naptha&r.

quests.title: Відсутній предмет
quests.desc: Reaction between &#BB95CFStyrene&r and &#D46C85Butadiene&r leads to &#827AFFStyrene-Butadiene&r.

quests.title: Відсутній предмет
quests.desc: &#827AFFStyrene-Butadiene&r can be mixed with either  &#9683F7Lead Tiny Dust&r or &#FEA8FFChromium Tiny Dust&r to get &#A1A1A1Styrene-Butadiene Rubber&r.

quests.title: Відсутній предмет
quests.desc: &#4DB85ERandom Access Memory&r is made in a &#5EC7E6Chemical Reactor&r with &#A1A1A1Styrene-Butadiene Rubber&r, &#D15EE6Argon&r, &7Antimony Dust&r, &#5ED2E6Aluminum Dust&r and &#5D76C2Silicon Wafers&r.

quests.title: Відсутній предмет
quests.desc:
&#DD91EDArgon&r reacting with &#83729ESilicon Dust&r and &#AAA0BAIridium Tiny Dust&r will give us &#919191Monocrystalline Silicon&r.

&#AAA0BAIridium&r is found as an ore in the overworld.

quests.title: Відсутній предмет
quests.desc: &#6EDDFFTurbo Upgrades&r add &#FFEB6E64EU/t&r of capacity per upgrade.

quests.title: Відсутній предмет
quests.desc: Mixing &#E6ED98Light Fuel&r with Steam will yield you &#DBE37FSteam Cracked Light Fuel&r.

quests.title: Відсутній предмет
quests.desc: Distilling &#DBE37FSteam Cracked Light Fuel&r will give you &#9C6C35Acetylene&r as a product.

quests.title: Відсутній предмет
quests.desc: &#9C6C35Acetylene&r mixed with &#DEAB6DHydroChloric Acid&r will give you &#F783F3Vinyl Chloride&r.

quests.title: Відсутній предмет
quests.desc: &#F783F3Vinyl Chloride&r can be mixed with either &#9683F7Lead Tiny Dust&r or &#FEA8FFChromium Tiny Dust&r to get &#F36EF5PolyVinyl Chloride&r.

quests.title: Відсутній предмет
quests.desc: &#F36EF5PolyVinyl Chloride&r with &#6EBAF5Platinum Plate, &#C4C362Cadmium Battery&r, &#F7BB57Annealed Copper Cable&r and &#57BFF7Digital Circuit Board&r will give us &#EBE56EProcessing Unit Board&r.

quests.title: Відсутній предмет
quests.desc: A singular &#919191Monocrystalline Silicon&r can be cut into 32 &#8FA4B5Silicon Wafers&r.

quests.title: Відсутній предмет
quests.desc: You have finally made it to the components required for the &#FFEB6EAllthemods Star&r!!

quests.title: Відсутній предмет
quests.desc: &#6EDDFFTurbo Upgrades&r add &#FFEB6E512EU/t&r of capacity per upgrade.

quests.title: Відсутній предмет
quests.desc: The &#FAAD28Heat Exchanger&r is haven for the &#4D7DFFExtreme Reactors&r Turbine lovers. This machine can produce an extonishingly large amount of Steam.

quests.title: Відсутній предмет
Розумний фільтр
quests.desc: Reactor can be fueled by Fuel Rods, these are the most basic ones you can craft.

quests.title: Centrifuging Uranium Dust
quests.desc: Centrifuging the Uranium Dust will give us some isotopes of Uranium which can be further processed into better rods.

quests.title: Відсутній предмет
quests.desc: Putting &9Water&r into a &#45BF56Reactor&r with fuel will yield us &#8F49C4Deuterium&r. There are other ways to get this as well but &#45BF56Reactors&r provide the fastest way possible.

quests.title: Відсутній предмет
quests.desc: &#5B75D4Chemically Reacting&r the &#8F49C4Deuterium&r with &#AABBFAOxygen&r will give us &#9C51DBHeavy Water&r. This can be put back into the &#45BF56Reactor&r.

quests.title: Відсутній предмет
quests.desc:
Heavy Water in a &#45BF56Reactor&r produces &#EB5266Tritium&r and &#C09EDEHeavy Water Steam&r.

The &#EB5266Tritium&r is used for advanced components whereas the &#C09EDEHeavy Water Steam&r can be recycled into &#8C47C9Heavy Water&r in a &#DEAB47Heat Exchanger&r.

quests.title: Відсутній предмет
quests.desc: Distilling &#F0C87DSteam-Cracked Naptha&r will give us &#8FD5E3Toluene&r.

quests.title: Відсутній предмет
quests.desc: Mixing together &#D4C35DSand&r, &8Flint&r, &#8DF0EENitrogen&r and &#69C9C7Toluene&r will give us &#D66D40Industrial TNT&r.

quests.title: Bypass Trick
quests.sub: You can crush Extreme Reactors Blutonium for Plutonium Dust
